dsh.config.host: Service host. Only loopback values (`127.0.0.1` / `localhost` / `[::1]`) are allowed; invalid values fall back to the default.
dsh.config.port: Expected port for the DSH web service (used for both detection and startup).
dsh.config.autoStart: Automatically start `dsh web` when the service is not running.
dsh.config.stopOnExit: Stop the plugin-started service when the last VS Code window closes.
dsh.config.extraArgs: Extra arguments appended when the plugin starts `dsh web` (e.g. `--trusted-host`).
dsh.config.bridgeEnabled: Enable the DSH page bridge (external links and file jumps between the panel and DSH).
dsh.config.workspaceRootIndex: Which workspace root to use as the working directory for the auto-started `dsh web` (0-based; falls back to the first root when out of range).
dsh.config.bridgeSilenceWarning: Suppress bridge warnings (e.g. when a DSH page is open outside the panel).
dsh.config.executablePath: Absolute path to the dsh executable (dsh.cmd on Windows). Empty = look up on PATH.

dsh.config.interactionOnlyWhenPanelHidde: When the DSH panel is visible, leave approvals/questions to the panel instead of popping a VS Code modal/QuickPick (avoids asking the same thing twice). Turn off to always show them in VS Code.
dsh.config.selectionLensEnabled: Selection toolbar: show the two clickable buttons (Add to DSH / Quick Edit) as a CodeLens above the first line of the selection.
dsh.config.changesEnabled:
**Change-set master switch** (F1-F5). When off: DSH edits are no longer recorded, the colored highlights and hover actions disappear, `F8` / `Shift+F8` go back to VS Code's own "next problem", and neither the `DSH Changes` tree nor the inline CodeLens is shown.

> Turning it off also **clears existing marks and the ledger** (including records persisted across Reload); turning it back on does not restore history. That is intentional: the switch must make the feature genuinely quiet, not just hide its UI.
dsh.config.checkpointsEnabled:
**Checkpoints master switch** (F9). When off: `~/.dsh/change-ledger` is not read at all (no I/O), the `DSH Checkpoints` view stays empty, and commands such as "restore to before this turn" report that the feature is disabled instead of issuing any restore request.

> Checkpoints only exist for regular git worktrees; non-git workspaces already show an empty-state note.
dsh.config.ideInteractionEnabled:
**IDE-interaction master switch** (F6 approval gate / F7 turn-complete notification / F8 questions & plan review / F10 selection toolbar). When off, none of these appear in VS Code and everything goes back to the DSH panel: no approval modal, no question QuickPick, no completion notification, and selecting text no longer shows the toolbar or the in-editor input box.

> Use it when you want file jumps plus change visualization only; the finer-grained settings below still apply individually.
dsh.config.quickEditEnabled:
**Quick Edit master switch** (F11). When off, `Alt+K`, the editor context-menu item "edit this code with an instruction", and the thread's "Quick Edit / send to DSH" all report that the feature is disabled and **never** send an instruction to DSH (no model turn is spent).

> It does not affect "Add to DSH / add selection to DSH": those only write a reference into the composer draft and never auto-send.
dsh.config.statusbarAgentEnabled: Whether to show the **DSH agent status item** in the status bar (F7: running - turn N / waiting for approval / idle). Turning it off hides only that item; the service-status item and completion notifications are unaffected.
